A1_AUTHENTICATED_OFFICIAL_CLASSIC.definition: Named author/work with strong bibliographic history and official/technical transmission.
A1_AUTHENTICATED_OFFICIAL_CLASSIC.can_create_master_doctrine: Only if the work is actually doctrinal in that domain; technical manual cannot create Feng Shui doctrine.

A2_VERIFIED_AUTHOR_CLASSIC.definition: Named classical author/work with verified attribution but not necessarily official manual.

B1_EARLY_ANONYMOUS_WITNESS.definition: Old witness is valuable and datable but author is unknown.

B2_VERIFIED_LATER_SCHOOL_TEXT.definition: Later school text with reasonably verified author/work.

C2_OCR_OR_SOURCE_CHAIN_INCOMPLETE.definition: OCR-only, uncollated, or quotation whose original witness is not verified.

promotion_gate: MASTER_DOCTRINE requires direct text + compatible domain + attribution not disputed + semantic meaning resolved.
A technical classic remains technical evidence; reputation cannot change domain.
B1 anonymous sources may establish existence of a motif, not a named-master doctrine.
C1/C2 can support search/cross-witness but cannot independently create a production rule.
If sources disagree, preserve conflict; do not vote by prestige.
